correctness.rationale: The minimum width occurs exactly at the balanced two-level partitions of centered unit vectors; its value sqrt[n/(2ab)] and finite minimizing direction count are reconstructed. The spherical chart (u0+v)/sqrt(1+||v||²) has exact Jacobian and width = (sqrt(n/(ab))+phi(v))/(sqrt2 sqrt(1+||v||²)); phi positive homogeneous and coercive on block zero-sum tangent space. Setting v=sqrt2 eps z yields convergence of bounded domain indicators to the full-dimensional polytope K:phi<=1, with zero boundary volume, so normalized conditional densities converge in L1 and hence total variation. Exact block simplex volume F_p(s)=sqrt(p)p^{p−1}s^{p−1}/(p−1)! and beta convolution give Vol(K)=p^{p−1/2}q^{q−1/2}/(n−2)!, yielding C_n and the Dirichlet(maxA,−minB,slack) law including singleton convention. The sharp lower and upper slope identities follow from extremal bounds for zero-sum vectors. Independent evaluation confirmed C3=C4=12/pi, C5=120 sqrt3/pi² and slope examples n=3–7; no finite extrapolation replaces the chart proof.
